Overture Maps Points of Interest: 60 Million POIs from Open Data

2026-09-11 Meta AI Overture Maps, points of interest, POI, Meta, open data, OpenStreetMap, geospatial data, AI for good, mapping
Read the source article

Quick summary

Meta AI highlights the Overture Maps Foundation's points-of-interest dataset, which comprises nearly 60 million POIs worldwide — data not previously available in OpenStreetMap, released as open data for mapping and geospatial applications.

Key takeaways

  • The Overture Maps Foundation's POI layer contains nearly 60 million points of interest
  • These POIs are data not previously available in OpenStreetMap, adding significant new coverage
  • The dataset is part of Overture Maps' mission to create a comprehensive, interoperable open map of the world
  • Overture Maps combines data from Meta, Microsoft, Amazon, TomTom, and the Linux Foundation
  • The POI layer supports applications in navigation, local search, urban planning, and commercial analytics
